name: British Naturalisation (British Overseas Territories Citizenship)

requirements.blocker_text: An application for 'British naturalisation as a British Overseas Territories Citizen' is submitted through Bermuda's Department of Immigration, billed on the same fee schedule as Bermudian status and Permanent Resident's Certificate applications. The substantive eligibility criteria (residence duration, character, language) were not stated on the fee/process pages reviewed.

evidence_required.document: Application form (specific form not itemised in the sources reviewed)

sources.title: Government of Bermuda -- All Immigration Fees: 'Applying for British naturalisation as a British Overseas Territories Citizen $1050.00', confirming the process exists and is administered by the Department of Immigration

notes: STATUS: DRAFT, part of Bermuda's initial build. This is the genuine BOTC 'citizenship' track for Bermuda, distinct from the local 'Bermudian status' routes (see bm_status_descent.json's notes for that distinction). Structurally unusual among the four BOTs built this session: Bermuda bills and processes British Naturalisation through the SAME Department of Immigration and fee schedule as Bermudian status and Permanent Resident's Certificate applications, rather than routing it through a separate Governor's Office or Passport Office portal as Anguilla, Montserrat, and Cayman all do -- flagged as a genuine structural difference, not an inconsistency in this dataset. Despite the tier-1 fee confirmation, no residence-duration, language, or character criteria were found in this pass -- draft status reflects that gap, consistent with how Montserrat's and Cayman's equivalent routes were also marked draft despite confirmed tier-1 existence and administering authority. citizenship_after_months is left null since it is unclear whether holding a PRC or Bermudian status is a precondition, or how long a wait is required.
